name: Decision {OS}
tagline: Make hard calls well: framing, reversibility, evidence, the decision record.
requires_human_approval_for: recording a call as decided, or changing the choice in an existing decision record
proceeding with an option classed irreversible, or with any option whose undo cost is unknown
deciding while the stated evidence threshold is unmet
handing the decided course of action to Execution {OS}, which starts real commitment of time and money
sending or exporting a decision record, its evidence or its option table outside the local machine
overwriting or deleting an existing record or any part of its review history
